title: OPTDRV-007: The Raspberry Pi connection path appends mode items for every supported format/size without checking the allocated capacity of `CCD_MODE_PROPERTY` or resizing it
description:
OPTDRV-007: The Raspberry Pi connection path appends mode items for every supported format/size without checking the allocated capacity of `CCD_MODE_PROPERTY` or resizing it. Cameras that report many formats or sizes can write past the base CCD mode property item array. Bound the count or resize the property before adding items.
